evidence: Labeled Wallet and primarily modifies src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and descriptor/PSBT handling.
rationale: Resolves long-standing interoperability failures with hardware signers that require PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB to reconstruct multisig scripts or verify change outputs. The description notes that BitBox02 currently rejects signing 2-of-3 multisig PSBTs produced by Core without this field, Trezor receives zeroed chain codes, and coordinators like Specter have been forced to inject xpubs via Python workarounds (#27583).
